description: Bind one price-book attribute to a canonical ITEM custom field by stable GUID during import, or atomically replace its confirmed mapping on an active book. For a closed enum, provide every exact vendor bookValue and the stable canonicalOptionId it represents. Vendor keys, labels, values, and grid rows stay unchanged; the saved adapter translates an item's option id into this book's value at pricing time. Numeric and numeric-band attributes bind to a decimal field and use an empty optionMappings list. Similar names from evaluate_price_book are suggestions only. Set confirmed true only after reviewing the complete mapping; the server validates it and activation refuses anything unconfirmed.

attributeKey.description: The vendor attribute key exactly as this book stores it.

confirmed.description: Whether an operator has reviewed this complete mapping.

optionMappings.description: Closed enums only: every vendor bookValue paired with its canonical custom-field option id. Use [] for numeric, numeric-band, and open-enum attributes.

name: map_price_book_attribute
title: Map Price Book Attribute
